title: Quinstar + Firepower, Rough
sheet_name: JD 300L/Ha - Rough - Quinstar + Firepower - GPS (9 Nov)
last_load: Quinstar + Firepower, Rough, Fri 6 Nov: run clean water through first

weather: Delta T 2–8 · wind under 15 km/h · gusts under 30
extra_checks: 10.25 L of Quinstar on the shelf
The 6 Nov tank used 10.25 L of the 15 L. If there's less than 10.25 L, stop and call Andy before you fill
Per 3 L: 1.5 L water, 6 mL Buff-It, 41 mL Quinstar, 1 mL Firepower, 10 mL Hasten, top up to 3 L. No clumps or separation after 10 minutes
Clean water run through the boom first
Last load was the 6 Nov rough tank
Bucket test: one nozzle for 1 minute at 3.4 bar

products.why: The suspension goes in once the water is buffered, so it disperses before the EC and the oil. You're at {before} L.
The EC goes in after the suspension. Small measure: it's 900 g/L. You're at {before} L.

ppe_note: Firepower 900 is a Schedule 6 poison: impervious elbow gloves and a face shield when you pour it. Quinstar irritates eyes and skin, and Buff-It has no SDS on file: goggles.
spray_rules: Rough only, today's areas (not the 6 Nov rough). Section control ON: no overlap onto fairways, tees, surrounds or greens. Firepower kills couch and bent
Sheet window is 6–9am, but don't start until Delta T is over 2: likely about 8:30 this morning with the heavy dew. Ask Andy before going past 9
Stop if it gusts over 30 km/h or blows toward a fairway, tee or green. Light easterly today (E 13 km/h, gusts 20–24), so drift goes west
10th tee start all day: the front nine is clear first. Do the front nine, then the back nine in the gaps behind groups. Never spray near golfers
No irrigation on the rough tonight. No mowing the sprayed rough for 2 days, and don't collect clippings from the first 3 mows
spray_more: Quinstar guide: 4.1 L/ha in 400 L water, avoid rain within 48 h and irrigation within 8 h, don't mow 2 days before or after. Firepower 900: Schedule 6, impervious elbow gloves and eye or face protection. Hasten: add last and keep agitating until it's sprayed out.
post_checks: JD decontaminated before it goes near a green again
Tank cleaner, then triple rinse through tank, boom and filters. Firepower residue kills bent
No irrigation on the rough tonight

flags.t: Quinstar stock: 4.75 L on hand, this tank needs 10.25 L
flags.d: The stocktake has Quinstar at 4.75 L since the 6 Nov tank used 10.25 L of the 15 L, and no delivery is recorded since. The sheet's note (uses all 15 L on the shelf) is carried over from 6 Nov. Unless more has come in, there's only enough for about 1.15 ha at 4.1 L/ha. The page asks for a shelf check before filling.

flags.t: Decontaminate the JD before anything else goes in it
flags.d: Firepower (haloxyfop) kills couch and bent at very low doses. If any of today's other tanks goes on the JD after this one, tank cleaner and a triple rinse through tank, boom and filters first. It's on the post-application checklist.

6–7am is 6 °C at 90–94% RH with heavy dew (6th station Delta T 1.3 at 4:40am). Delta T climbs past 2 around 8:30 as it warms to 9–12 °C. The sheet's 6–9am window was set for gusts over 30 from 9am; today gusts stay 20–24 km/h all day and it's dry, so the window could run later. Your call: the page says ask Andy before going past 9.

Firepower kills couch, so any overlap or drift onto fairway edges will show. Wind E–ENE 13 km/h through the morning pushes drift to the west side of each rough: keep section control on the boundaries and the boom low.
Dry today and Tuesday. Showers Wednesday morning (60%, about 0.7 mm), roughly 46–50 h after a morning spray. The Quinstar guide says avoid rain within 48 h.

flags.t: Buff-It: no label or SDS on file
flags.d: Handled as an acidifier (goggles, elbow gloves) with a 'drum label read' tick. It goes in first; haloxyfop's ester is more stable in buffered water.

Firepower 900 is registered for forestry and industrial grass control, not turf; 90 g/ha haloxyfop here is under its label rates, which Victoria allows off-label. Neither Firepower nor Quinstar lists fescue as tolerant; Quinstar only suppresses kikuyu (2 sprays 14–21 days apart).
flags.s: ADAMA Firepower tech note · Quinstar guide

flags.t: Nozzles: grey at 3.4 bar is about 284 L/ha
flags.d: Grey is ISO size 06: about 2.5 L/min at 3.4 bar. At 7.1 km/h that's about 284 L/ha on 75 cm nozzle spacing. The bucket test confirms it. Quinstar's guide rate is 4.1 L/ha in 400 L water; this tank is 300 L/ha.
flags.s: ISO 10625 nozzle colour code · ADAMA Quinstar guide
